Any kernel element has two limiting diagonal means, forcing distance at least 1/2 to each normalized finite positive block; constant Toeplitz 1/2 I gives equality. The scalar second-order recurrence and total-variation bound yield \(N\) times residual at least \(2(1-q)\), while an explicit C1 two-boundary-layer bump gives a matching limsup. The standard Banach-space quotient closed-range characterization proves nonclosed range. The embedded exact-rational checker passed 2607 assertions but is supplementary.
